# Target

> > Target is America's general merchandise retailer offering shopping, loyalty programs, seasonal promotions, and omnichannel services across 1800+ locations.

Target.com is the e-commerce hub for Target Corporation, featuring a comprehensive product catalog, Target Circle loyalty ecosystem (including Target Circle, Target Circle Card, and Target Circle 360), and seasonal shopping destinations. The site emphasizes value, convenience, and rewards-based shopping experiences.

## Key Topics

- Target Circle
- Target Circle Card
- Target Circle 360
- Target Circle Rewards
- Loyalty Program

- Seasonal Promotions

## Loyalty & Membership Programs

- [Target Circle™](https://www.target.com/circle): Target Circle loyalty program with membership perks and rewards
- [Target Circle™ Card: Save 5% at Target](https://www.target.com/circlecard): Target Circle Card product page with 5% savings and benefits
- [Target Circle 360™ : Target](https://www.target.com/l/target-circle-360/-/N-2rguk): Target Circle 360 premium membership with delivery and Shipt benefits

## Shopping & Navigation

- [Target : Expect More. Pay Less.](https://www.target.com): Target homepage with shopping, loyalty programs, and seasonal promotions
- [Shop All Categories : Target](https://www.target.com/c/shop-all-categories/-/N-5xsxf): Target product catalog navigation across all merchandise categories
- [Top Deals at Target](https://www.target.com/c/top-deals/-/N-4xw74): Target top deals and promotions on toys, electronics, home decor
- [Stores Near Me : Target](https://www.target.com/store-locator/find-stores): Target store locator with hours, directions, and 1800+ locations

## Gift Services

- [Gift Registry & Wish lists : Target](https://www.target.com/gift-registry): Gift registry and wish list creation for weddings, babies, and occasions

- [Easter Decorations : Target](https://www.target.com/c/easter-decorations/-/N-4uswe): Easter decorations including wreaths, table decor, and yard items
- [Easter Outfits : Shop Stylish Looks | Target](https://www.target.com/c/easter-outfits/-/N-4xwcj): Easter clothing and fashion for the whole family with spring styles
